description: MA Lighting grandMA3 onPC v2.4.2.2 — v2.4.2.2 under Wine in a Kasm 1.19 desktop container, with a persistent Wine prefix and host networking for MA-Net/Art-Net/sACN.
notes: Kasm Wine container (not a Windows streaming tile). MA Lighting software is licensed and is NOT bundled: download grandMA3_onPC_win_v2.4.2.2.zip from https://www.malighting.com/downloads/products/grandma3/ and drop it in the persistent /home/kasm-user/grandma-installers folder, then relaunch — the launcher unzips it, installs into the persistent Wine prefix and auto-starts it thereafter. Host networking is enabled for MA-Net3 UDP 8700, Art-Net UDP 8000 and sACN UDP 5568.
